title: SSE error frame
description: A terminal `error` frame on a turn or child-run stream. The `data` payload is a full Error record (schema/error.json): the same `{ error, code }` shape and closed `code` catalog an ordinary HTTP error carries, so a stream failure classifies identically to a request failure. The `id` mirrors the SSE `id:` transport cursor (see sse-frame.json); it is not part of `data`.

event.description: SSE event name for this frame.
